blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reasoning about an individual clinical case requires connecting heterogeneous patient
observations to general biomedical knowledge.
Patient records describe observations , e.g., laboratory measurements, images, reports,
medications, longitudinal events ( Johnson et al., 2023 ; Johnson et al., 2019b ) ;
whereas biomedical knowledge bases describe general relations among diseases, drugs, genes,
and phenotypes ( Chandak et al., 2023 ; Bodenreider, 2004 ; Stear et al., 2024 ) .
Neither is sufficient alone when a question depends on a link between the two, and such
questions are common: across 28,582 MIMIC-IV ICU stays, 29.9% exhibit a laboratory-evident
organ state that never appears in the coded diagnoses while the patient receives a medication
that PrimeKG lists as contraindicated for that state (App. B ).
Answering such questions correctly requires reasoning about the current measurement and the drug-specific
relation; either source in isolation leaves the question undecidable.

药物,纵向事件(Johnson等人,2023;Johnson等人,2019b;);

和酚类(Chandak等人,2023年;Bodenreider,2004年;Stear等人,2024年)

关系; 任何孤立来源都使问题无法决定。

blocks.en:
Existing works model each of these sides, but rarely their connection.
Multimodal clinical models fuse EHR data, text, and images into predictive representations, but
discard the links from individual observations to biomedical concepts ( Hayat et al., 2022 ; Yao et al., 2024b ; Yao et al., 2024a ) .
Knowledge-graph methods supply external facts or build patient-specific graphs for prediction and language-model reasoning ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
Their patient side, however, is typically derived from structured codes or clinical text alone;
imaging, genomic, and biospecimen evidence is either excluded or fused outside the graph, so no single representation carries all modalities through to the biomedical knowledge backbone.
Where multiple modalities are represented graphically, they are generally not linked to standardized biomedical concepts ( Wu et al., 2024 ) .
Consequently, no explicit path runs from a source observation, through its normalized concept,
to the biomedical relation used to interpret it, and the connection cannot be retrieved or ablated.
blocks.zh:
现有的作品模拟了这些方面中的每一个,但很少它们之间的联系.
多式联运临床模型将EHR数据、文本和图像纳入预测性表述,但
放弃个人观察与生物医学概念的联系(Hayat等,2022;Yao等,2024b;Yao等,2024a)。
知识-图法为预测和语言-模型推理提供外部事实或构建针对患者的图表(江等,2024;江等,2025;文等,2024;吴等,2025.).
然而,患者一方通常仅取自结构化代码或临床文本;
成像、基因组学和生物谱系证据要么被排除,要么在图外被熔化,因此没有一个单一的表述方式将所有方式都贯穿到生物医学知识主干线上。
在以图形形式表示多种模式的情况下,它们一般不与标准化生物医学概念相挂钩(Wu等,2024.).
因此,没有一条明确的路径从源的观察,通过其正常化的概念,
与用于解释的生物医学关系,连接无法被取回或被消散。

blocks.en:
We introduce MM-KG ( M ulti m odal K nowledge G raph), which represents multimodal patient evidence and a biomedical knowledge backbone in a single typed graph.
Each modality passes through its own harmonizer, converting raw input into typed
observation nodes rather than a fused vector.
A vision-language model turns chest radiographs into calibrated textual findings;
brain MRIs are segmented into regional abnormality findings under a normative
model; and codes, measurements, and report text are resolved by vocabulary
lookup, value-aware rules, and entity linking.
Provenance edges retain each observation’s source and timestamp, and a route-prioritized aligner links the resulting concepts to PrimeKG ( Chandak et al., 2023 ) , preferring exact identifier routes over synonym and parent hops (§ 3.3 ).
Because instance and ontology nodes keep separate identities, each layer can be traced or
removed independently.
Query-conditioned retrieval then assembles a compact subgraph per question, joining the relevant patient neighborhood to candidate-conditioned domain relations under deterministic rules with no access to the label.
The result can then be serialized for a downstream LLM or used as input to a GNN, exposing a path from source observations, to aligned concepts, to the relation supporting an answer (Fig. 1 ).
This explicit structure makes the patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their alignment separately traceable and testable.

blocks.en:
We build two independently constructed graphs: 51,844 MIMIC-IV patients with chest radiographs and reports, and 1,000 ADNI participants spanning longitudinal imaging, history, cognition, genetics, and biospecimens ( Veitch et al., 2022 ) .
Because instance and ontology layers remain separately addressable, a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 design can isolate patient evidence, KG relations, and their interaction (§ 3.5 ), a decomposition which fused representations do not support.
Our primary evaluation targets questions in which neither source is sufficient alone.
On 3,200 controlled MIMIC questions that link a condition documented in laboratory values or radiology reports to a drug relation, each source alone leaves performance near chance, whereas together they yield a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of + 0.194 +0.194 ( p < 0.001 p{<}0.001 ), reproduced on the 70-item ADNI test set at + 0.299 +0.299 across a different disease domain and evidence channel.
On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG exceeds MindMap by + 0.131 +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items a candidate-only prior cannot resolve (0.582 against 0.375), while deleting the answer-bearing relation, replacing or shuffling packets reduces Hits@1 from 0.575 to 0.185–0.299 against 0.200 chance.
The effect therefore requires the specific correspondence that alignment makes explicit, which query-conditioned retrieval supplies at AUROC 0.731 with 1,206 input tokens, against 8,157 for the strongest generic policy.
Where one source suffices, each behaves as expected: patient measurements drive mortality prediction for both consumers while static PrimeKG adds nothing measurable (App. I ), and the same relations improve biomedical fact-checking by + 0.063 +0.063 to + 0.420 +0.420 (App. Table 7 ).

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows. (1) A typed instance–knowledge graph construction framework in which multimodal observations, their provenance, and their alignment to a biomedical backbone remain separately addressable, so that each layer can be traced or ablated rather than fused away. (2) Query-conditioned retrieval that joins patient evidence to candidate-conditioned relations, recovering the answer path for 99.7% of positive items and reaching AUROC 0.731 with 6.8 × 6.8\times less context than the strongest vector, full-context, or typed one-hop policy. (3) A factorial evaluation showing that patient evidence and KG relations combine superadditively on questions that require both, yielding interactions of + 0.194 +0.194 (MIMIC) and + 0.299 +0.299 (ADNI) AUROC, and that removing or corrupting the answer-bearing alignment returns held-out ranking to the no-knowledge level or below, whereas static KG context alone does not improve outcome prediction.
MM-KG construction, retrieval, benchmark, and evaluation code will be released upon acceptance. 1 1 1 The KGs themselves are reproducible from credentialed, non-redistributable MIMIC-IV and ADNI data.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Multimodal clinical representation. Clinical representation learning has progressed from longitudinal EHR models such as RETAIN ( Choi et al., 2016 ) and GRAM ( Choi et al., 2017 ) to multimodal architectures that combine structured records, text, and medical images.
MedFuse ( Hayat et al., 2022 ) , DrFuse ( Yao et al., 2024b ) , and DDL-CXR study fusion ( Yao et al., 2024a ) under missing or asynchronous modalities.
MedGTX ( Park et al., 2022 ) jointly encodes structured EHR graphs and clinical text, while MUSE ( Wu et al., 2024 ) represents patient–modality relationships with a bipartite graph and evaluates on both MIMIC and ADNI.
MedMod ( Elsharief et al., 2025 ) provides a benchmark for multimodal prediction using MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR.
These methods are important prediction baselines, but they do not explicitly preserve the paths from source observations through normalized biomedical concepts to external biomedical relations.
blocks.zh:
多式联运临床表现. 临床表现学习从RETAIN(Choi等,2016年)和GRAM(Choi等,2017年)等纵向EHR模型向结合结构化记录,文字,医疗影像的多模式架构发展.
MedFuse(Hayat等,2022年),DrFuse(姚等,2024年b),和DDL-CXR研究聚变(姚等,2024年a)在缺失或同步模式下.
MeDGTX(Park等,2022年)联合编码结构化的EHR图和临床文本,而MUSE(Wu等,2024年)则代表了病人-模式关系与双相图,并评价MIMIC和ADNI。
MedMod(Elsharief等,2025年)为使用MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-CXR进行多式联运预测提供了基准。
这些方法是重要的预测基线,但并没有通过生物医学规范化的概念,明确保留从源头观测到外部生物医学关系的路径.

blocks.en:
Patient representations and biomedical KGs. Multimodal KGs associate symbolic entities with heterogeneous attributes or evidence ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
Biomedical resources such as PrimeKG and PetaGraph ( Chandak et al., 2023 ; Stear et al., 2024 ) provide large concept-level backbones but do not by themselves represent a patient’s multimodal clinical history.
Several methods enrich patient or code representations with biomedical knowledge.
MMUGL ( Burger et al., 2023 ) maps structured codes and concepts extracted from clinical text into a shared UMLS-derived representation; ClinVec and MedTok combine standardized codes with textual or relational knowledge ( Johnson et al., 2026 ; Su et al., 2025 ) ;and GraphCare constructs patient-specific graphs using external biomedical resources ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) .
KG4Diagnosis proposes a hierarchical multi-agent framework that constructs a graph from unstructured medical text for diagnostic reasoning ( Zuo et al., 2025 ) .
These studies show the value of combining patient records with biomedical knowledge; MM-KG builds on this further by retaining source-level multimodal observations, recording how each was derived, and linking the resulting concepts explicitly to a shared biomedical backbone.
blocks.zh:
患者表达和生物医学 KG. 多式联运公司将具有不同属性或证据的象征性实体联系在一起(Chen等,2024年)。
PrimeKG和PetaGraph等生物医学资源(Chandak等,2023;Stear等,2024)提供了庞大的概念级骨干,但本身并不代表患者的多模式临床史.
几种方法用生物医学知识丰富了病人或代码的表示.
MMUGL(Burger等,2023年)将从临床文本中提取的结构化代码和概念绘制成一个共享的UMLS衍生代表;ClinVec和MedTok将标准化代码与文本或关系知识相结合(Johnson等,2026年;Su等,2025年;GraphCare用外部生物医学资源构建出针对患者的图表(Jiang等,2024年).
KG4Diagnosis提出了一个分级的多剂框架,从无结构的医学文本中构建出用于诊断推理的图表(Zuo等,2025年).
这些研究表明了将病历与生物医学知识相结合的价值;MM-KG通过保留源级多模式观测,记录每个模式的产生方式,以及将由此产生的概念明确与共享生物医学主干网联系起来,在此基础上更进一步。

blocks.en:
Knowledge retrieval for clinical prediction. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) retrieves external evidence before producing an answer.
In clinical prediction, RAM-EHR retrieves relevant information from external knowledge sources ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , while KARE organizes knowledge into communities and retrieves community-level evidence for healthcare prediction ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) .
RAD retrieves disease-centered guideline knowledge and uses it to align multimodal features for clinical diagnosis ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
KARE and RAD are especially relevant comparators, but they use retrieved knowledge primarily to construct summaries or guide latent representations.
In contrast, MM-KG retrieves an explicit typed subgraph spanning both patient evidence and biomedical relations, which can be consumed by an LLM or a heterogeneous GNN.
blocks.zh:
临床预测知识检索. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)(Lewis等,2020年)在给出答案之前取回了外部证据.
在临床预测中,RAM-EHR从外部知识来源取回了相关信息(Xu等人,2024年),而KARE则将知识组织到社区并取回社区一级的保健预测证据(Jiang等人,2025年)。
RAD检索以疾病为核心的指导知识,并用它来调整临床诊断的多模式特征(Li等,2025年)。
KARE和RAD是特别相关的参照国,但它们主要利用检索到的知识来构建摘要或指导潜在的表述。
相形之下,MM-KG检索到一个覆盖病人证据和生物医学关系的明确的打字子图,可以被LLM或异形的GNN所消耗.

blocks.en:
KG retrieval and verification for medical LLMs. Several methods use biomedical graphs to support medical language models.
MindMap ( Wen et al., 2024 ) retrieves graph evidence for diagnostic reasoning, and DR.KNOWS ( Gao et al., 2023 ) incorporates UMLS knowledge into diagnosis prediction.
DOSSIER checks claims against structured patient records and biomedical knowledge graphs while limiting the exposure of private records to the LLM ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
FAITH instead evaluates generated medical claims by decomposing responses into atomic statements and scoring their support using paths in a biomedical graph ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
MedGraphRAG ( Wu et al., 2025 ) is the closest prior system: it builds a hierarchical graph over MIMIC-IV, anchors entities to standardized vocabularies, retains source attribution, and conditions retrieval on the query.
It operates over document chunks, so attribution is recorded per passage rather than per observation, and its patient side carries no laboratory values, imaging, or genomics.
MM-KG records provenance for each typed observation across modalities and makes each observation–concept link a separate, removable edge.
Our experiments then address a complementary question: whether separately controlled patient evidence, external biomedical relations, and their explicit alignment improve prediction and grounding before an answer is generated.
Table 1 summarizes these distinctions across representative multimodal, knowledge-enhanced, and graph-retrieval methods.

blocks.en: 3 Method: multimodal instance–knowledge graphs
blocks.zh: 3个 方法:多式联运实例-知识图

blocks.en:
Overview. MM-KG represents patient evidence and biomedical
knowledge within a single graph while keeping their node sets disjoint,
connected only by explicit alignment edges.
This separation is the central design decision.
Because each alignment edge is an individually addressable object rather than a
component of a fused representation, it can be retrieved, traced, and removed,
and the contribution of a given patient–relation correspondence to a downstream
prediction can be measured directly rather than inferred.
Modalities are accordingly not fused into a shared embedding, and the benefit comes from the correspondence rather than from added graph text: length-matched graph text with the correspondence disrupted reduces held-out ranking to near chance (§ 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
概览. MM-KG代表病人的证据和生物医学
在一个单一的图表中掌握知识,同时保持其节点的断开,
仅通过明确的对齐边缘连接。
这种分离是中央设计的决定.
因为每个对齐边缘都是一个个别可处理的对象而不是一个
可以取回、追踪并取出,
以及特定病人对下游关系的贡献
预测可以直接衡量,而不是推断。
因此,方式不融合为共享嵌入,其好处来自函证而不是所添加的图表文本:与函证相匹配的长度图表文本中断后,被搁置的排名降至近乎偶然(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem setting and graph representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的设置和图表表述

blocks.en:
Let 𝒟 = { x p , e , m } \mathcal{D}=\{x_{p,e,m}\} be a multimodal corpus, where p p indexes an instance, e e an event/encounter, and m ∈ ℳ m\in\mathcal{M} a modality.
Let ℬ = ( V O , E O , R O ) \mathcal{B}=(V_{O},E_{O},R_{O}) be an external ontology or KG.
Given a query q q about instance p p , the goal is to answer from a compact subgraph while retaining a trace to the supporting evidence in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} or ℬ \mathcal{B} .
Figure 2 summarizes the general architecture from multimodal inputs to query-conditioned model consumption.
We define a multimodal instance–knowledge graph as 𝒢 = ( V , E , R , T , τ , a , π ) , V = V I ∪ V O , R = R proc ∪ R align ∪ R O . \mathcal{G}=(V,E,R,T,\tau,a,\pi),\qquad V=V_{I}\cup V_{O},\qquad R=R_{\mathrm{proc}}\cup R_{\mathrm{align}}\cup R_{O}. Here, V I V_{I} and V O V_{O} are the disjoint sets of instance and ontology nodes, T T is the set of node
types, each edge ( u , r , v ) ∈ E (u,r,v)\in E carries a type r ∈ R r\in R , and the functions τ \tau , a a , and π \pi store node types, attributes, and provenance.
The partition of R R is what allows each layer to be traced or removed

blocks.en: 4 Datasets and Implementation
blocks.zh: 4 数据集和执行

blocks.en:
We instantiate MM-KG as independently constructed MIMIC and ADNI graphs linked to PrimeKG ( Chandak et al., 2023 ) , using the same provenance-preserving construction with dataset-specific extractors (Appendices B , H , and K ).
The MIMIC graph covers 51,844 patients, combining MIMIC-IV EHR events ( Johnson et al., 2023 ) with MIMIC-CXR radiographs and reports ( Johnson et al., 2019a ; Johnson et al., 2019b ) : diagnoses, prescriptions, procedures, and laboratory measurements become provenance-linked observations, and BiomedCLIP ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) with CheXpert-calibrated thresholds ( Irvin et al., 2019 ) converts radiographs into textual findings.
The ADNI graph covers 1,000 participants and 4,977 visits spanning imaging, medical history, cognition, genetics, and biospecimens ( Veitch et al., 2022 ) ; regional brain-MRI features from FastSurfer ( Henschel et al., 2020 ) are compared with normative models, their deviations become imaging findings, and direction-aware anchors to HPO phenotypes connect these findings to the other clinical domains.

MIMIC图覆盖了51,844名患者,将MIMIC-IV EHR事件(Johnson等,2023年)与MIMIC-CXR放射图和报告(Johnson等,2019年a;Johnson等,2019年b)结合起来:诊断,处方,程序和实验室测量成为出处关联的观测结果,而BiomedCLIP(Zhang等,2023年)与CheXpert校正阈值(Irvin等,2019年)将放射图转化为文字结论.
ADNI图覆盖了1,000名参与者和4,977次访问,涵盖成像、医学史、认知、遗传学和生物物种(Veitch等,2022年);FastSurfer(Henschel等,2020年)的区域脑-MRI特征与规范模型进行比较,它们的偏差成为成像结果,方向-意识锚地与HPO酚类连接这些发现与其他临床领域.

blocks.en:
We evaluate outcome prediction using 28,582 MIMIC ICU stays and 619 ADNI participants, biomedical fact-checking using 1,920 balanced questions, and patient-specific joins using 3,200 MIMIC items and the ADNI paired contraindication benchmark.
The ADNI benchmark contains 510 development items, a 114-item validation set and a 70-item test set; the latter provides the primary cross-cohort ADNI result.
The primary MIMIC experiments use Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and a two-layer heterogeneous GraphSAGE consumer, while the primary ADNI test evaluation uses Qwen3.5-9B with thinking disabled.
We report AUROC or balanced accuracy as appropriate, with paired-item bootstrap inference for MIMIC and participant-clustered inference for ADNI.
Further details on entity linking, evaluation settings, model implementation, and ADNI-specific evaluation details are provided in Appendices C , D , J , and L , respectively.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: We will evaluate MM-KG on whether patient evidence and biomedical knowledge interact (§ 5.1 ), how MM-KG compares with external methods (§ 5.2 ), whether the interaction depends on the alignment edges (§ 5.3 ), retrieval context efficiency (§ 5.4 ), and how each source performs alone (§ 5.5 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Aligned patient and knowledge evidence is superadditive
blocks.zh: 5.1 一致的病人和知识证据是超级补充

blocks.en:
Because instance and ontology nodes remain separately addressable, either evidence source can be withheld or supplied independently, which permits the 2 × 2 2{\times}2 design of § 3.5 : condition A receives neither source, B the patient modalities, C the KG relations, and D both.
Fused representations do not admit this design.
We call the two sources superadditive when the improvement from supplying both exceeds the sum of the improvements from supplying each alone, that is, when the interaction I M I_{M} of § 3.5 is positive.

由于实例和肿瘤节点仍可单独地址,证据来源可以不提供或独立提供,这允许第3.5节的2×2 2.times}2设计: 条件 A既不接受来源,B是病人模式,C是KG关系,D都是。
虚构的表述不承认这种设计。
我们称这两个来源是超级补充的,因为供应的改善既超过了每个供应的改进总和,也就是第3.5节的相互作用I M IQM}是积极的。

blocks.en:
The MIMIC join benchmark targets questions for which such an interaction is expected: across all 28,582 MIMIC-IV ICU stays, 29.9% exhibit a laboratory-evident organ state, (e.g., creatinine > 2.0 {>}2.0 , bilirubin > 2.0 {>}2.0 , platelets < 100 {<}100 , or hemoglobin < 8 {<}8 ) that is absent from the coded diagnoses while PrimeKG lists a current medication as contraindicated for that state.
Items come from four question families with same-patient matched negatives and length-matched KG lists (App. E ).
blocks.zh:
MIMIC合并了预期进行这种互动的基准问题:在所有28 582个MIMIC-IV ICU停留中,29.9%显示实验室显性器官状态(例如:creatinine > 2.0 {>}2.0;bilirubin > 2.0 {>}2.0;血小板 < 100 {<}100;或血红蛋白 < 8 {<}8),而PrimeKG将目前药物列为该状态的禁药。
项目来自四个问题家庭,同一名病人的底片和长度相匹配的KG清单(App.E)。

blocks.en: Table 2: Factorial results in both cohorts: balanced accuracy (chance 0.500) with AUROC in parentheses. A : conventional record; B : + + patient modalities; C : + + complete KG list; D : both. Interaction: I M I_{M} .
blocks.zh: 表2:两个组的系数结果:平衡精确度(chance 0.500),括号中为AUROC。 A:常规记录; B: + + 患者模式; C: + + 完整的KG列表; D: 两者兼有. (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). Interactive: I M IQM}.

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports the factorial results on the 3,200 MIMIC items and the 70-item ADNI test set.
On MIMIC, supplying the patient modalities alone changes balanced accuracy by − 0.002 -0.002 and the KG alone by + 0.031 +0.031 ( p < 0.001 p{<}0.001 ), so additive effects would improve condition D by 0.029; it improves by 0.150, an interaction of + 0.122 +0.122 in balanced accuracy and + 0.209 +0.209 in AUROC ( p < 0.001 p{<}0.001 ).
The interaction is positive and significant in every family on both metrics, including the two-hop mechanism questions, and remains + 0.179 +0.179 (95% CI [ + 0.160 , + 0.197 ] [+0.160,+0.197] ) on the 2,400 items outside the drug-effect family, so the pooled estimate is not driven by that family’s large effect.
blocks.zh:
表2报告了3 200个MIMIC项目和70个ADNI测试组的因子结果。
在MIMIC上,单提供患者方式即可改变平衡精度为-0.002-0.02,单KG值为+0.031+0.031(p < 0.001 p{<}0.001),因此,添加效应可使D状态改善0.029;单提供患者方式即可改善0.150,其相互作用为+0.122+0.122的平衡精度和+0.209+0.209的AUROC(p < 0.001 p{<}0.001)。
互动在包括双跳机制问题在内的两个指标上对每个家庭都是积极而重要的,在药物效应家庭以外的2400个项目上,互动仍为+0.179+0.179(95% CI [+0.160,+0.197] [+0.160,+0.197]),因此集合估计并非由该家族的"大效应"所驱动.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Patient–KG interaction across question families, controls, language models, and cohorts: AUROC I M I_{M} with 95% CI; marker area ∝ n \propto\sqrt{n} (Table 18 ).
blocks.zh: 图3:患者-KG在问题家庭、控制、语言模型和组群之间的相互作用:AUROC I M IQQM}95%的CI;标记区为\\proto\sqrt{n}(表18)。

blocks.en:
The lower blocks of Table 2 apply the same design to the independently constructed ADNI graph, using a paired contraindication benchmark that asks whether a candidate drug has a PrimeKG contraindication relation to a condition in the participant’s medical history. Positive and negative items are paired across participants for the same drug and receive identical KG packets, so candidate identity alone cannot determine the label.
On the 70-item test set, scored once after the validation analysis and pipeline were frozen, the AUROC interaction is + 0.299 +0.299 (95% CI [ + 0.065 , + 0.532 ] [+0.065,+0.532] , p = 0.0135 p=0.0135 ), close to the + 0.319 +0.319 on the 114-item validation set, and it remains positive with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on both.
All four prespecified destructive controls fall below condition D after Holm correction, and removing the decisive contraindication edge alone reduces AUROC from 0.860 to 0.714 (App. L ).
Thus, while ADNI differs from MIMIC in disease domain, evidence channel, and language model, the interaction is still reproduced.
blocks.zh:
表2的下行区块对独立构建的ADNI图采用了同样的设计,采用了对等的禁药基准,该基准询问候选药物是否与参与者医疗史上的条件有PrimeKG禁药关系。 阳性和阴性物品在参与者之间为同一种药物配对,并获得相同的KG包,因此候选人身份不能单独决定标签.
在70项测试集上,在验证分析与管道被冻结后得分一次,AUROC相互作用为+0.299+0.299(95% CI [+0.065,+0.532] [+0.065,+0.532],p=0.0135 p=0.0135),接近+0.319+0.319的114项验证集上,与Quen2.5-7B-Instruct在两者上保持正向.
在Holm改正后,所有四种预先规定的破坏性控制都低于条件D,仅去除决定性的禁忌边缘即可将AUROC从0.860减少到0.714(App.L.)。
因此,虽然ADNI在疾病领域,证据通道和语言模型上与MIMIC不同,但互动仍然被复制.

blocks.en:
This interaction persists in all conducted control experiments (Figure 3 ).
Restricting to the 1,895 items whose candidate drug appears in both label classes brings condition A to chance (AUROC 0.485) while the interaction remains + 0.194 +0.194 ( p < 0.001 p{<}0.001 ); it is positive across three LLMs and under prose or typed-triple rendering (App. Table 8 ), and is preserved when answer-bearing edges are stratified by independent prescribing behavior (App. G ).
It is also specific to conditions documented outside the codes: when coded diagnoses already reveal the condition, C reaches 0.783 and the interaction disappears (App. Table 9 ), so the interaction requires the laboratory and report evidence that codes do not contain.
Overall, neither patient evidence nor biomedical knowledge is sufficiently informative in isolation; modeling their interactions is required.
blocks.zh:
在所有已进行的控制实验中,这种相互作用持续存在(图3)。
限制在两个标签类别中都有候选药物的1,895个物品,这给条件A带来了机会(AUROC 0.485),而相互作用仍然为+0.194+0.194(p < 0.001 p{<}0.001);在三种LLM和活口或打字三重渲染下呈阳性(App.表8),当含有答案的边缘通过独立规定行为分层时保留(App.G)。
也特指代码外所记录的病情:当被编码的诊断已经揭示出病情时,C会达到0.783,相互作用会消失(App. 表9),所以相互作用需要实验室和报告代码不包含的证据.
总体而言,无论是病人证据还是生物医学知识都无法单独提供足够信息;需要建立互动模型。

blocks.en: 5.2 MM-KG outperforms existing methods on patient-specific reasoning
blocks.zh: 5.2 MM-KG在针对患者的推理方面比现有方法要好

blocks.en:
We next compare MM-KG with appropriate existing methods on held-out five-candidate ranking: each item pairs one ICU stay with five administered drugs, one of which has an answer-bearing PrimeKG path, with decoys matched on prescription frequency, graph degree, packet length, and drug class ( n = 1,244 n{=}1{,}244 patients; chance Hits@1 0.200).
Condition D reaches Hits@1 0.575 (95% CI [ 0.548 , 0.603 ] [0.548,0.603] ) against 0.293, 0.304, and 0.278 for A, B, and C, an interaction of + 0.287 +0.287 (95% CI [ 0.244 , 0.331 ] [0.244,0.331] , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们将MM-KG与现有的适当方法相比,按5个标准排列:每件一对ICU停留在5种服用的药物上,其中一种药物具有有答案的PrimeKG路径,配有处方频率、图度、包长和药物类别相匹配的诱饵(n=1,244 n{=}1{,}244名病人;机率Hits@1-0.20)。
条件D达到Hits@1 0.575 (95% CI [0.548, 0.603] [0.548, 0.304], A, B, C的0.278, 相互作用为+ 0.287 + 0.287 (95% CI [0.244, 0.331] [0.244, 0.331], p < 0.001 p < 0.001]).

blocks.en:
Table 3 compares MM-KG with two external methods.
MindMap ( Wen et al., 2024 ) +PrimeKG, scored with the same Qwen3.5 protocol, trails MM-KG by 0.131 Hits@1 (95% CI [ 0.100 , 0.163 ] [0.100,0.163] , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
An adapted GraphCare-BAT model ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) trained on 19,085 labeled pairs is statistically indistinguishable from MM-KG on the full split, but its score rises from 0.609 to 0.645 when the patient side of its input is removed ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), indicating that it ranks candidates by properties of the drug rather than by their relation to the patient.
On the identity-hard subset ( n = 598 n=598 ), where a candidate-only prior ranks the wrong drug and a formulary lookup cannot resolve the item, MM-KG reaches 0.582 while both GraphCare variants fall to 0.375 and 0.381.
On ADNI, a deterministic PrimeKG lookup reaches AUROC 0.956, so that comparison measures recovery of an explicit patient–relation match rather than differences between methods (App. Table 13 ); the five-candidate design could not be reproduced there because participant medication sets are too small to defeat candidate-identity shortcuts.
Overall, MM-KG matches the strongest existing method where candidate identity suffices and exceeds every external method where it does not.
blocks.zh:
表3将MM-KG与两种外部方法进行比较。
MindMap (Wen等, 2024) +PrimeKG, 得分相同 Quen3.5 协议, 径向 MM-KG 以 0. 131 Hits@ 1 (95% CI [0.100, 0.163] [0.100,0.163], p < 0.001 p < 0.001).
一种经过调整的GraphCare-BAT模型(Jiang等,2024年)在19,085个标签对子上经过了培训,在统计学上与MM-KG在完全分出时无法区分,但其分数从0.609分上升到0.645分,取出其输入的患者一方(p < 0.001 p < 0.001),表明其根据药物的属性而不是与患者的关系对候选人进行排名.
在身份硬子集(n = 598 n = 598)上,只有候选者才能对错误的药物进行排位,而且公式检查无法解决该物品,MM-KG达到0.582,而GraphCare的两个变体都降到了0.375和0.381.
在ADNI上,确定性的PrimeKG检查达到了AUROC 0.956, 这样比较可以衡量一个明确患者的恢复情况 — — 关系匹配而不是方法之间的差异(App. 表13); 在那里无法复制5个候选人设计,因为参与者的药物组太小,无法击败候选人身份快捷键。
总体而言,MM-KG与现有最强方法相匹配,只要候选人身份足够,就超过任何外部方法。

blocks.en: Table 3: External methods on held-out five-candidate ranking (MIMIC; chance Hits@1 0.2). “Identity-hard”: items a candidate-only prior ranks wrongly.
blocks.zh: 表3:关于5名候选人排名的外部方法(MIMIC;Hits@1 0.2)。 “硬性身份”:只列入候选人先前的排名错误。

blocks.en: 5.3 Patient–KG interaction requires correct alignment, not graph text
blocks.zh: 5.3 病人 - KG 交互需要正确对齐,而不是图文

blocks.en:
Because retrieval returns each relation as a separately addressable object, the patient–relation correspondence can be disrupted while the patient evidence and nearly all of the graph text stay in place.
We apply three such disruptions to condition D on the five-candidate MIMIC ranking benchmark of § 5.2 : deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the answer candidate’s packet, replacing the answer candidate’s packet (the relations retrieved for it) with a length-matched packet from another candidate, and shuffling packets across the five candidates.
All three fall below condition D ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Table 4 ): deleting the edge returns Hits@1 to the level of condition A, and shuffling drives it below the 0.200 chance level.
Because the decoys are matched on prescription frequency, graph degree, packet length, and drug class, the drop reflects the loss of the correspondence rather than of graph text.
The ADNI 70-item test set shows the same ordering, with all four prespecified disruptions below condition D (after Holm correction): removing the decisive edge lowers AUROC from 0.860 to 0.714, and keeping node names while removing their relations returns it to the level of condition A.
MM-KG also cites the evidence it uses: on the ADNI validation set, all 85 attempted KG citations referred to relations in the supplied packet, and after the decisive edge was removed the model never cited it (App. L ).
blocks.zh:
由于检索返回每个关系作为一个单独的可地址对象,病人-关系通信可能会被打乱,而病人的证据和几乎所有的图表文本都会留在原地.
我们用三个这样的中断来作为D的条件:一个是5分5.2分的MIMIC排名基准:从答案候选人的包中删除单一的有答案关系,另一个候选人用一个长相匹配的包取代答案候选人的包(为它找到的关系),五个候选人用散打包。
所有三个跌入条件D以下(p < 0.001 p < 0.001;表4):去掉边缘返回 Hits@1 到条件A的级别,而打乱则将它推向了0.200机会级别以下.
由于诱饵在处方频率,图度,包长,和药物类上相匹配,所掉落的会反映对应物的丢失,而不是图文的丢失.
ADNI 70项测试集显示相同的顺序,所有四个预先指定的中断都低于条件D(在Holm修正后):去掉决定性的边缘将AUROC从0.860降至0.714,保留节点名称同时去掉它们的关系使其返回条件A的水平.
MM-KG还引用了它使用的证据:在ADNI验证集中,所有85个试图引用的KG在所提供包中提及的关系,在决定性边缘被移除后,模型从未引用过(App.L.)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Correspondence disruption. MIMIC: five-candidate ranking ( n = 1,244 n{=}1{,}244 ); ADNI: test set ( n = 70 n{=}70 ). a on MIMIC: another candidate’s length-matched packet; on ADNI: degree- and relation-matched null packet.
blocks.zh: 表4:通信中断。 MIMIC: 5名候选人排名(n = 1,244 n{=}1{,}244;ADNI:测试集 (n = 70 n{=}70). a 关于MIMIC: 另一个候选人的长度相匹配包; 关于ADNI:学位相匹配和关系相匹配的空包.

blocks.en:
The patient-side contribution localizes in the same way.
On MIMIC, removing laboratory values or report findings reduces Hits@1 by 0.148 and 0.123 ( p < 0.001 p{<}0.001 ), whereas removing imaging findings or coded history has no measurable effect (App. N.3 ); on the ADNI validation set, medical history alone with the KG reaches AUROC 0.831 against 0.853 for the full record, and it is the only patient block whose enablement estimate ( + 0.294 +0.294 ) exceeds the prespecified minimum detectable interaction of 0.137 (App. L ).
The interaction therefore depends on the alignment edges: mismatched packets return both cohorts to the no-knowledge level, and in each cohort the interaction arises from the evidence block that contains the condition the question concerns.
blocks.zh:
患者方的贡献也以同样的方式本地化.
在MIMIC上,去除实验室值或报告结果将Hits@1减少0.148和0.123(p < 0.001 p{<}0.01),而去除成像结果或编码历史没有可衡量的效果(App.N.3);在ADNI验证组上,仅与KG的医学史就达到AUROC 0.831,而全记录为0.853,这是唯一一个患者区块,其赋能估计值(+ 0.294 + 0.294)超过预设的最低可探测相互作用0.137(App.L.)。
因此,互动取决于对齐边缘:不匹配的包将两个组都恢复到无知识的水平,在每个组中,互动来自包含问题所涉条件的证据块。

blocks.en: 5.4 Query-conditioned retrieval recovers correspondence with less context
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 有查询条件的检索回收来函的上下文较少

blocks.en:
We next measure the cost of retrieving the correspondence on the patient-disjoint MIMIC test split (2,398 items, 1,079 patients), scored once after all policies were frozen (App. N.2 ).
MM-KG reaches AUROC 0.731 with 1,206 input tokens, 6.8 × 6.8\times fewer than the 8,157 used by the strongest generic policy, SapBERT vector retrieval (0.712, p = 0.01 p{=}0.01 ); the remaining policies score 0.062–0.204 lower (Figure 4 ), and when capped at MM-KG’s budget they recover the answer path for at most 26% of positive items and fall to 0.526–0.638.
On the drug-balanced subset, whose candidate drugs appear in both label classes, the two leading policies tie (0.695 against 0.693) while the token gap remains ( 6.7 × 6.7\times ), so the consistent advantage is context efficiency.
MindMap-PrimeKG reaches 0.686 and recovers a complete answer path for 72.6% of positive items, against 99.7% for MM-KG.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们衡量从病人与非混合的MIMIC测试分拆(2 398件,1 079个病人)上收回信件的费用,在所有保险单被冻结后一次得分(第N.2页)。
MM-KG达到AUROC 0.731,输入符为1,206个,比最强通用政策SapBERT矢量检索(0.712,p = 0.01 p{=}0.01)使用的8,157次少了6.8×6.8分;其余政策得分为0.062–0.204分更低(图4),在被MM-KG预算封顶时,最多可收回26%正项的答案,并降至0.526–0.638分.
在药物平衡的子集上,其候选药物出现在两个标签类别中,两种主要政策是平分(0.695对0.693),而象征性差距则仍然存在(6.7×6.7\时),所以一致的优势是上下文效率.
MindMap-PrimeKG达到0.686,为72.6%的正子恢复了完整的解答路径,而MM-KG为99.7%.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Retrieval accuracy against context cost on the held-out MIMIC split: test AUROC (95% CI) vs. median input tokens.
blocks.zh: 图4:对持有的MIMIC拆分的上下文成本进行检索的准确性:测试AUROC(95% CI)对中位输入符.

blocks.en:
Retrieval can fail by missing the answer path or by retrieving it without the model using it.
MM-KG misses the path on only 4 of 1,199 positive items and resolves more positives than any other deployable policy: 753, against 714 for the 32K full context, which retrieves 98.2% of paths but loses 463 positives with the path present (App. Figure 6 ).
On ADNI, varying path length from one to three hops showcases both failure modes: a static relation packet falls below closed-book answering despite usually containing the gold path, and interactive graph querying is accurate at one hop but drops to 0.670 and 0.590 balanced accuracy at two and three hops (App. M ).
Query-conditioned retrieval thus supplies the required correspondence at a fraction of the context, with fewer combined failures than any generic policy.
blocks.zh:
检索可能因为缺少答案路径而失败,或者在没有模型使用的情况下检索.
MM-KG只错过了1,199个正项中的4个正项,并且解决了比任何其他可部署政策更多的正项:753,而32K全上下文为714个正项,它收回了98.2%的正项,但与当前正项相比损失了463个正项(同上图6)。
在ADNI上,从一到三跳的不同路径长度展现出两种失败模式:一个静态关系包虽然通常包含金色路径,却倒在了闭页解答下;交互式图表查询在一跳是准确的,但在两跳和三跳时下降到了0.670和0.590平衡的精度(App. M.).
因此,与任何通用政策相比,查询和附加条件的检索在上下文的一小部分提供所需函文,但合并失败较少。

blocks.en: 5.5 MM-KG’s multimodal patient representations for outcome prediction
blocks.zh: 5.5 MM-KG用于结果预测的多式病人表现

blocks.en: Table 5: ICU mortality ablations: Δ \Delta AUROC when each channel is removed (ablated − - full). LLM: 28,582 stays; GNN: 5,676-stay test split. ∗ ∗ ∗ p < 0.001 {}^{***}p{<}0.001 , ∗ p < 0.05 {}^{*}p{<}0.05 .

Finally, we examine each source on tasks that do not require their combination.
For ICU mortality, the zero-shot LLM reaches AUROC 0.733 with the full MM-KG prompt, against 0.570 with demographics alone, and the trained GNN reaches 0.804, against 0.778 for a laboratory-only model; laboratory values contribute most for both (Table 5 ).
The GNN also outperforms logistic regression on 30-day readmission (0.644 against 0.548; App. J ), the harmonizer’s structured imaging findings exceed the radiologist’s verbatim prose by + 0.025 +0.025 AUROC (App. H ), and in ADNI, adding biomarkers and imaging to clinical history improves prognosis balanced accuracy from 0.595 to 0.652 (App. L ).
Removing PrimeKG leaves mortality AUROC unchanged for both consumers, within run-to-run noise (App. I ), consistent with § 5.1 : the knowledge graph contributes when a question requires the patient–relation correspondence.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们审查每个来源,研究不需要综合处理的任务。
对于ICU的死亡率,零发LLM在MM-KG的全速速率下达到AUROC 0.733,而仅人口统计就达到0.570,受过训练的GNN达到0.804,而仅用于实验室模型的为0.778;实验室值对两者的贡献最大(表5)。
GNN在30天的重新接收(0.644对0.548;App.J.)上也超越了后勤回归,协调者的结构成像结果比放射学家的逐字记录多出+0.025+0.025 AUROC(App.H.),在ADNI中,在临床史上增加了生物标记和成像,使预测的平衡准确度从0.595提高到0.652(App.L.))。
删除主线 KG给两个消费者的死亡率AUROC没有变化,在运行中的噪音范围内(App.I),这与第5.1节一致:当一个问题需要病人的对应关系时,知识图会有所贡献。

blocks.en:
Conversely, when a question concerns a relation directly, complete PrimeKG edges improve balanced accuracy on 1,920 pharmacological questions in all eight relation families, by + 0.063 +0.063 to + 0.420 +0.420 , whereas entity names, length-matched incorrect neighborhoods, and corrupted names do not (App. Table 7 ); because the model follows behaviorally corroborated and contradicted edges alike (App. G ), traceability to an edge does not establish clinical correctness.
Each source is therefore informative on the task suited to it, and interaction (§ 5.1 ) arises when a question requires both.
blocks.zh:
反之,当一个问题直接涉及关系时,完整的PrimeKG边缘会提高所有8个关系家庭1,920个药理问题的平衡准确度,比0.063+0.063到+0.420+0.420,而实体名、长相匹配的不正确邻接区和被腐蚀的地名则不然(App.表7);由于该模型遵循的行为与边缘相同且相矛盾(App.G),可追溯到边缘并不能确定临床正确性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced MM-KG, which joins multimodal patient evidence to a biomedical knowledge graph through explicit, provenance-preserving alignment edges.
In two independently constructed cohorts, the two sources are individually uninformative on questions that require both but superadditive together, and replacing the aligned relations with mismatched ones returns performance to the no-knowledge level.
Query-conditioned retrieval recovers these links with a fraction of the context of generic retrieval, and MM-KG outperforms external graph methods on the items that require consulting the patient.
Knowledge graphs thus help clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between a patient’s state and the relation a question requires.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了MM-KG,它通过清晰的,从源头保持的校正边缘,将多式病人证据与生物医学知识图相结合。
在两个独立构建的组群中,两个来源在需要两个但相互补充的问题上各自没有信息,用不匹配关系取代对等关系,使业绩恢复到无知识水平。
查询有条件的检索用一般检索的上下文的一小部分来恢复这些链接,MM-KG在需要咨询病人的物品上比外部图表方法要好.
因此,知识图有助于临床的LLMs不是作为背景背景,而是作为病人状态与问题要求的关系之间的明确联系。

blocks.en:
Each admission connects to diagnoses, prescriptions, procedures, time-bounded laboratory features, and chest-radiograph studies.
Diagnoses and prescriptions are preserved as typed patient-side observations before their standardized concepts are aligned with PrimeKG.
Laboratory measurements remain attached to their admission and observation window, including their values, units, timestamps, and source-table identifiers.

实验室测量仍附在它们的接收和观测窗口上,包括它们的值、单位、时间戳和源表识别符。

blocks.en:
Each chest radiograph is processed with BiomedCLIP ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) to produce scores for named radiographic findings.
Finding-specific thresholds are calibrated against CheXpert reference labels ( Irvin et al., 2019 ) .
Findings that pass their thresholds become textual imaging-finding nodes linked to the source radiograph and study.
The ontology aligner then maps these finding nodes to compatible phenotype concepts in PrimeKG.
This image-to-finding-to-concept path allows image content to participate in graph retrieval without discarding the original radiograph or its provenance.

blocks.en:
Radiology reports are processed independently.
Report-derived findings become separate observation nodes connected through reported-finding edges.
Consequently, an image-derived finding and a report-derived finding remain distinguishable even when they align to the same biomedical concept.
This separation supports channel ablations and allows retrieved evidence to be traced to either the image model or the clinical report.
Entity-linking routes and coverage are described in App. C .

This section provides the terminology routes and mapping-coverage details summarized in § 3.3 .

We first remove 110 formulation and vehicle strings, including diluents and flushes, which account for 19.7% of raw prescription rows.
The pipeline then maps 91.1% of the remaining prescription volume (47.9% of distinct strings), and 92.8% of the mapped volume has an ATC class.

The eligible patient pools contain 2,307 patients for contra-labs , 456 for contra-report , 2,143 for drug-effect , and 476 for mechanism .
We sample 400 pairs from each family.
Three shortcuts were discovered and closed during construction, in order.
(1) Presence leak : drugs labeled safe often had no KG list, making an absent KG block a perfect predictor of “no.”
We therefore require every negative item to have a non-empty list.
(2) Length leak : positive lists were approximately three times longer because drugs contraindicated in common organ states tend to have long relation lists.
We match negatives on rendered character count, yielding final total-prompt positive-to-negative length ratios of 0.99–1.03.
(3) Near-synonym leak : labels are defined by PrimeKG identifiers, but models read strings, and distinct nodes can have nearly identical names, such as “edema” and “pulmonary edema.”
We reject a negative if its list contains a subset-containment near-synonym of any patient concept visible in the prompt; the residual rate is 0–1% per family.
Before control (3), the drug-effect family was degenerate (specificity 0.04).
A pilot with permissive wording (“could any finding…”) also saturated the decision threshold.
The released question instead requires an identified match: “answer yes only if you can identify a specific finding that appears in the adverse-effect list.”
This wording restores a significant interaction on both metrics, although a tendency to answer yes remains at the 0.5 threshold, as reported in the main text.
The stored ICU prompt used a legacy “first 24 hours” header although its values came from the prespecified first-48-hour window.
This wording error is identical in all conditions and therefore does not affect their comparison.
The released prompt corrects the header.

redacted matched examples are included in App. P .

blocks.en:
Across the three set-membership fact-checking families ( n = 720 n{=}720 ), retrieval capped at 12 edges yields balanced accuracy 0.718, with sensitivity 0.483 and specificity 0.953.
This pattern is consistent with the model treating an omitted relation as absent.
Complete neighborhoods raise balanced accuracy to 0.913, with sensitivity 0.911 and specificity 0.914.
For the side-effect family, truncated retrieval (0.642) performs worse than no retrieval (0.725).
PrimeKG lists a median of 43 side effects per drug and as many as 338, so a 12-edge list omits the queried effect for 78% of positive items.
Warning the model that the evidence may be incomplete recovers + 0.142 +0.142 on one family and provides no gain on the others.
The failure therefore requires more complete retrieval rather than a prompt-only correction.
All main-paper KG conditions therefore use complete lists.

blocks.en:
For every drug–condition pair we compute the log odds ratio of prescription given the condition over 183,950 admissions.
PrimeKG’s indication layer is strongly corroborated: the mean log odds ratio is + 1.13 +1.13 , compared with + 0.08 +0.08 for unlabeled pairs ( p < 0.001 p{<}0.001 ).
By contrast, contraindication pairs are not avoided as a group ( + 0.12 +0.12 ), and their mean is indistinguishable from that of unlabeled pairs.
We split the cohort into disjoint patient halves and require avoidance to replicate across both halves.
This procedure identifies 649 behaviorally corroborated contraindications and 1,817 relations that observed prescribing reliably contradicts, with replication rates of 97.6% and 96.3% against 50% chance.
Inspection of the latter group identifies clear errors; for example, PrimeKG lists fondaparinux as contraindicated in heparin-induced thrombocytopenia even though it is a standard treatment.
When we repeat the fact-checking audit on both subsets, the model follows corroborated and contradicted edges similarly ( + 0.104 +0.104 versus + 0.130 +0.130 ; not significantly different).
We additionally intersect these behavioral partitions with the answer-bearing contraindication edges of the controlled join benchmark, retaining each selected positive item together with its same-admission matched negative.
The behaviorally corroborated subset contains 152 items (76 matched pairs) and retains an AUROC interaction of + 0.145 +0.145 (95% CI [ + 0.074 , + 0.224 ] [+0.074,+0.224] , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
The behaviorally contradicted subset contains 580 items (290 matched pairs) and gives a nearly identical interaction of + 0.150 +0.150 (95% CI [ + 0.111 , + 0.190 ] [+0.111,+0.190] , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
Together, these analyses show that the model can join patient evidence to a supplied relation regardless of whether observed prescribing behavior corroborates that relation; they do not establish the clinical correctness of the underlying KG edge.

blocks.en:
For patients lacking a chest film, the full-prompt and no-imaging conditions are identical, yet scores differ across serving runs because batch composition changes floating-point reduction order.
Across 19,678–21,383 identical-prompt pairs, the AUROC gap between runs is + 0.0003 +0.0003 – + 0.0042 +0.0042 , and the median per-item score drift is 2.5 × 10 − 3 2.5\times 10^{-3} .
We therefore treat ± 0.004 \pm 0.004 AUROC as the noise floor; all interaction estimates exceed it by more than an order of magnitude.
Within-run comparisons (all join-task conditions; all ladder conditions) are scored by a single engine instance and do not incur this term.

blocks.en:
The trained consumer in Table 5 is a two-layer heterogeneous GraphSAGE network.
It uses HeteroConv with a per-edge-type SAGEConv , sum aggregation, hidden size 32, and dropout 0.5.
Frozen pretrained features are projected to the hidden size: SapBERT name embeddings for patient-side concept nodes, PubMedBERT description embeddings for PrimeKG nodes, Bio_ClinicalBERT embeddings for matched radiology reports, and BiomedCLIP features for radiograph studies.
The admission’s demographics and first-48-hour laboratory features are concatenated with the pooled graph representation before a two-layer prediction head.

被冻结的预受训练特征被预测为隐藏大小:为病人侧概念节点所嵌入的SapBERT名称;为PrimeKG节点所嵌入的PubMedBERT描述;为对应的放射学报告所嵌入的Bio_ClinicalBERT;为放射学研究所嵌入的BiomedCLIP特征.

最后图组成. 酚型ADNI图包含64,786个保留发现,213个CUI,264个映射概念,71,240个患者级节点,334,764个患者级边缘.
另有9,264个外部概念节点和41,246个概念到概念边缘分别被存储.
患者层次和概念层次的计数使用不同的分母,不应进行归纳.

blocks.en:
Coverage did not imply connectivity. The expanded Desikan–Killiany–Tourville (DKT) to UBERON crosswalk raised imaging linkage coverage from 35.8% to 88.4% and total feature-column coverage from 44.5% to 86.6%.
These values measure coverage rather than mapping correctness.
Under anatomical alignment alone, the main concept component contained 9,650 of 9,905 nodes and all nine non-imaging domains, while all 80 imaging concepts remained outside it in 46 fragments.
Of the 182,298 edges touching mapped brain regions, 99.8% were tissue-expression edges from the noisy layer excluded during graph construction.
No retained path therefore connected imaging concepts to disease, drug, or phenotype concepts.
blocks.zh:
覆盖面并不意味着连通性。 将Desikan-Killiany-Tourville(DKT)扩展至UBERON横道,将成像连接覆盖率从35.8%提高到88.4%,将全部地物柱覆盖率从44.5%提高到86.6%。
这些数值衡量覆盖范围,而不是绘制正确度。
仅在解剖学上,主要概念部分包含9,905个节点中的9,650个和所有9个非成像域,而所有80个成像概念都留在了46个片段外.
在182,298个触摸到映射出大脑区域的边缘中,99.8%是图构造时排除出噪音层的组织表达边缘.
因此,没有保留路径将成像概念与疾病、药物或酚类概念联系起来。

blocks.en:
The phenotype-anchored configuration retained the anatomical located-in edges and added direction-aware has-imaging-phenotype edges.
Ninety-two imaging columns mapped to 22 HPO phenotypes and created 27,442 phenotype-anchoring edges.
Twenty of these phenotypes entered the main component and gained two- to four-hop paths to cognitive, behavioral, genetic, and medication concepts.
This was a structural repair rather than a mapping-accuracy result: none of the 96 DKT-to-HPO review rows has been adjudicated, and 60 use lower-confidence regional fallbacks.
For the held-out dynamic benchmark, a separate answerable-concept set maps 112 of 126 concepts, including 104 that resolve to exact PrimeKG nodes.
These values also measure coverage rather than manually verified accuracy.
blocks.zh:
phanotype-anchored配置保留了解剖定位边缘,并增加了方向-意识有-phonetype边缘.
92个成像柱被映射到22个HPO苯基并创造了27,442个苯基-安打边缘.
其中20种酚类进入了主要成分,并获得了认知,行为,遗传,和药物概念的2到4个途径.
这是结构性修复,而不是绘图准确性的结果:96个DKT至HPO审查行中没有一个被裁定,60个使用较低的区域信心回落.
对于搁置的动态基准,一个单独的可回答概念设定了126个概念中的112个,包括104个决心精确PrimeKG节点的地图.
这些数值还衡量覆盖范围,而不是人工核实的准确性。

blocks.en:
Static and graph-native boundaries. On three-class diagnosis, the flat condition reaches macro-F1 0.6177 ± 0.026 0.6177\pm 0.026 .
The concept-mapped patient-graph condition reaches 0.6921, but a flat control model given the same added columns reaches 0.7383 ± 0.014 0.7383\pm 0.014 .
The additional data, rather than concept mapping, therefore explain the improvement over the original flat condition.
A discontinued cognitive-slope regression is also negative: the flat model reaches Pearson correlation 0.4034 ± 0.023 0.4034\pm 0.023 , whereas earlier graph-feature configurations range from 0.244 to 0.274.
The cognition-dropout experiment suggests greater robustness for the graph condition.
However, it lacks a non-graph concept-pooling control that would separate graph routing from feature dilution, so we do not interpret it as evidence of a graph gain.
blocks.zh:
静态和图态边界。 在三等诊断中,平分状态达到宏-F1 0.6177 ± 0.026 0.6177\pm 0.026.
概念图上的病人图病情已达0.6921,但同一增加的列的平面控制模型已达0.7383±0.014 0.7383\pm0.014。
因此,补充数据,而不是概念绘图,解释了与原先的平地条件相比的改善。
停止的认知-斜面回归也是负的:平面模型达到皮尔逊相关性0.4034±0.023 0.4034\pm 0.023,而更早的图形特征配置范围从0.244到0.274.
认知-跳出实验表明,图表条件更坚固.
然而,它缺乏一个非图式的概念集合控制,可以将图的路由和特征稀释分开,因此我们不把它解释为图增益的证据.

blocks.en:
The pre-anchor graph-native experiment also gives a null result across ten seeds.
The matched no-graph network reaches macro-F1 0.6087 ± 0.0215 0.6087\pm 0.0215 , and the four-layer graph-attention network reaches 0.6109 ± 0.0529 0.6109\pm 0.0529 .
Because the pre-anchor graph contains no cross-modal concept path from imaging to another domain, this experiment cannot distinguish an ineffective consumer from a graph with no useful structure to propagate.
A phenotype-anchored graph-native rerun is therefore required before the phenotype repair can support a message-passing claim.
blocks.zh:
预锁定图-内生实验也给出了10个种子的无效结果.
相匹配的无图网络达到宏-F1 0.6087±0.0215 0.6087\pm 0.0215,四层图意网络达到0.6109±0.0529 0.6109\pm 0.0529.
由于预锁定图没有包含从成像到另一个域的跨模式概念路径,这个实验无法区分一个无效的消费者和一个没有有用的结构来传播的图.
因此,在对苯基进行修复后,需要重新进行苯基-安化图式操作,才能支持传递信息的索赔。

blocks.en: Appendix L ADNI paired contraindication benchmark: validation, test evaluation, and evidence controls
blocks.zh: 附录L ADNI 配对禁用基准:验证、测试评价和证据控制

blocks.en:
Construction. The candidate-conditioned retriever is deterministic rule-based code.
It normalizes the candidate drug, applies family-specific relation whitelists, and retrieves its complete bounded PrimeKG packet.
It has no access to the answer-bearing medical-history block or the hidden label.
The median, 90th-percentile, and maximum packet lengths are 623, 947, and 1,298 tokens.
The paired contraindication benchmark uses cross-patient, same-candidate positive and negative pairs with identical KG packets and at most two items per participant.
A positive item requires a displayed mapped condition and a contraindication edge between the candidate and that condition.
A negative item means only that none of the mapped conditions displayed in the record has such an edge.
blocks.zh:
建筑业. 具有候选条件的检索器是基于规则的决定性代码.
它使候选药物正常化,应用家庭特异性关系白名单,并取回其完整的PrimeKG包.
它无法进入有答案的医学历史街区或隐藏的标签.
中位数,为第90个百分位数,最大包长为623,947个,代币为1,298个.
配对的禁用基准采用交叉病人、相同扫描的正对和负对,其中KG包相同,每个参与者最多有两个项目。
阳性物品需要在候选人与该条件之间显示一个显示的映射条件和相反的边缘。
负项仅指记录所显示的映射条件无一有这种边缘.

blocks.en:
The dynamic study contains 510 development items from 265 participants, 114-item validation from 61 participants, and a 70-item test set from 39 participants, scored once with the frozen Qwen3.5-9B pipeline after the validation analysis was fixed.
The validation bank contains 57 matched pairs and 53 candidate drugs; only three candidates occur in more than one pair.
Qwen3.5-9B is served locally with vLLM in bfloat16, and constrained yes/no probabilities provide the continuous score.
The primary confidence interval clusters by participant.
Pair-clustered, candidate-clustered, and equally weighted candidate analyses serve as sensitivity checks.
blocks.zh:
动态研究包含265位参与者的510个开发项目,61位参与者的114个项目验证,以及39位参与者的70个项目测试集,在验证分析确定后与被冻结的Quen3.5-9B管道打分一次.
验证库收录了57对配对和53个候选药物;只有3个候选人在多对中出现.
Wen3.5-9B在bfloat16中以vLLM在当地服务,受限是/无概率提供连续分数.
参与者的主要信任间隔集群。
对等分组、对候选人分组和对候选人进行同等加权分析,是对敏感性的检查。

blocks.en:
Interaction and controls. With Qwen3.5-9B, validation AUROC is 0.5636 for A (neither channel), 0.5534 for B (patient only), 0.5506 for C (PrimeKG only), and 0.8590 for D (both).
The interaction is + 0.3186 +0.3186 with participant-clustered 95% CI [ + 0.1806 , + 0.4539 ] [+0.1806,+0.4539] ; pair- and candidate-clustered analyses are also positive and exclude zero.
The aligned condition exceeds shuffled PrimeKG (0.5131), a degree/relation-matched null (0.5260), decisive-support removal (0.6316), and node names without relations (0.5531).
blocks.zh:
互动与控制。 使用Quen3.5-9B,验证AUROC为0.5636A(两个信道都没有),0.5534为B(只有病人),0.5506为C(只有PrimeKG),0.8590为D(两个都).
其相互作用为+0.3186+0.3186与参与者集群95% CI [+0.1806,+0.4539] [+0.1806,+0.4539];对子和候选集群分析也为正数并排除为零.
对齐的条件超过了shuffled PrimeKG(0.5131),一个学位/关系匹配的无效(0.5260),决定性支持去除(0.6316),以及没有关系的节点名称(0.5531).

The factorial interaction is I M = + 0.2988 I_{M}=+0.2988 (95% CI [ + 0.0650 , + 0.5319 ] [+0.0650,+0.5319] ; predeclared p = 0.0135 p=0.0135 ).

blocks.en:
Modality localization. On validation, the full patient representation reaches AUROC 0.5546 without KG and 0.8529 with the correct KG packet.
Medical history alone with the KG reaches 0.8313, while removing all patient information yields 0.5003 without KG and 0.5046 with KG.
The medical-history enablement estimate is + 0.2936 +0.2936 (95% CI [ + 0.1618 , + 0.4237 ] [+0.1618,+0.4237] ) and is the only tested patient block whose magnitude exceeds the prespecified 0.137 minimum detectable interaction.
Independent repeats change no endpoint by more than 0.0022, below the frozen 0.010 reproducibility threshold.
blocks.zh:
模式本地化. 在验证时,完全的病人代表到达AUROC 0.5546没有KG,0.8529有正确的KG包.
仅与KG的医学史就达到了0.8313,同时去除所有患者信息就得到0.5003分,没有KG,0.5046分与KG.
医学-历史授权估计值为+0.2936+0.2936 (95% CI [+0.1618,+0.4237] [+0.1618,+0.4237]),是唯一被测试的患者区块,其体积已超过预先指定的0.137最小可探测相互作用.
独立再现不改变端点超过0.0022分,低于被冻结的0.010再生阈值.

blocks.en: Table 13: Exploratory external-method comparison on the ADNI paired contraindication benchmark validation bank ( n = 114 n=114 ). Methods use their method-specific evidence construction; the direct PrimeKG lookup is the primary no-model comparator. a MM-KG condition D is the previously frozen Qwen3.5-9B patient-plus-KG result on the same validation bank; its complete candidate KG packet differs from the evidence representations used by MindMap and GraphCare, so the row is shown for within-bank context rather than as a controlled architecture-only comparison.
blocks.zh: 表13:关于ADNI对等反指标基准验证库的探索性外部方法比较(n=114n=114)。 方法使用其特定方法的证据构建;直接的PrimeKG查询是主要的无模型参照物. a MM-KG条件D是同一验证库上以前被冻结的Qwen3.5-9B患者+-KG结果;其完整的候选KG包与MindMap和GraphCare使用的证据表示不同,因此该行显示为银行内部上下文,而不是作为受控架构唯一的比较.

blocks.en:
Longitudinal multimodal prognosis. A separate five-seed study asks whether memory declines faster over roughly four years than the patient’s baseline predicts.
Among 619 participants, clinical history and examination alone reach balanced accuracy 0.595, while adding biomarkers and imaging reaches 0.652, a + 0.057 +0.057 change with the same sign in all five seeds.
The graph-augmented counterparts reach 0.577 and 0.622.
Both graph increments change sign across seeds and remain smaller than the variation across seeds.
We therefore interpret only the multimodal increment as a consistent effect.
The label is based on follow-up rather than baseline diagnosis; App. source files record the rejected label variants and their baseline and follow-up correlations.
blocks.zh:
纵向多式预后. 一项单独的五种种子研究询问记忆在大约4年内是否比病人的基线预测更快地下降.
在619名参与者中,仅临床史和检查就达到平衡的精度0.595,而添加的生物标记和成像则达到0.652,一个+0.057+0.057的变化,在所有五个种子中都有相同的标志.
图解对应方达到0.577和0.622.
两种图例增量在种子之间都发生变化,而且仍然小于种子之间的变化。
因此,我们仅将多式联运递增解释为一种一贯的效果。
标签基于后续而不是基线诊断; App. source文件记录了被拒绝的标签变体及其基线和后续关联.

blocks.en:
Development-stage laboratory/vital-sign join. An earlier pooled family contains 194 matched items from 86 participants.
Laboratory values or vital signs indicate a condition absent from the coded record, and the question asks whether that condition is contraindicated with a current drug.
Balanced accuracy is 0.505, 0.541, 0.500, and 0.701 for A–D; the interaction is + 0.165 +0.165 with patient-clustered 95% CI [ + 0.101 , + 0.225 ] [+0.101,+0.225] .
However, the family has no protected test split, and its design choices were made while examining the pooled bank.
We therefore report it as development evidence; the ADNI test set above provides the primary cross-cohort result.
Here “occult” means absent from an ADNI enrollment checkbox, not a condition missed by a clinician.
blocks.zh:
开发阶段实验室/vital标志加入. 一个较早的集合家庭有来自86名参与者的194个对应项目。
实验室值或生命征兆表明编码记录中缺少一个条件,问题在于该条件是否与当前药物相反。
A-D的平衡精度为0.505,0.541,而A-D的平衡精度为0.701;与患者集群为95% CI [+0.101,+0.225] [+0.101,+0.225]的相互作用为+0.165+0.165.
然而,该家庭没有受保护的测试分拆,其设计选择是在检查集合银行时做出的.
因此,我们把它报告为发展证据;上面的ADNI测试提供了主要的交叉结果。
这里的“神秘”是指没有参加ADNI入学登记簿,而不是临床医生错过的条件。

blocks.en:
ADNI explanation and provenance audit. We conducted a separate post-hoc explanation audit on the 114-item
Qwen3.5 validation bank. Condition D produced valid structured output for
all 114 items. Across 85 attempted KG citations, every cited relation was
present in the supplied packet; 53 cited the decisive answer-bearing edge,
32 cited another valid in-packet edge, and no unsupported KG citation was
observed. Relative to the 57 positive items, decisive-edge citation recall
was 53/57 (0.930).
blocks.zh:
ADNI 解释和来源审计。 我们单独对114项目进行了事后解释性审计
Quen3.5验证库. 条件 D生产了有效的结构化产出
所有114项。 在85起KG引用中, 每一个引用的关系都是
包含在所提供的包中;53 引用了决定性的有答案的边缘,
32 引用了另一个有效的内包边缘,没有不支持的 KG 引用
观察。 相对于57个积极项目,决定性的引证召回
编号为53/57(0.930)。

blocks.en:
Removing the decisive supporting edge did not induce fabrication of the
missing relation. All 114 support-removed outputs remained structurally
valid; among the 57 positive items, the model cited another available in-packet relation in 48 cases and abstained in 9, and it never cited the removed identifier. The positive-item citation-attempt rate decreased from 55/57 to 48/57 ( Δ = − 0.123 \Delta=-0.123 ,
95% CI [ − 0.204 , − 0.039 ] [-0.204,-0.039] ).
Removing only provenance headers leaves predictive performance essentially unchanged: AUROC is 0.8587 with the original D prompt and 0.8480 without provenance headers, for a paired difference of − 0.0108 -0.0108 (95% CI [ − 0.0579 , + 0.0322 ] [-0.0579,+0.0322] ).
Pair- and candidate-clustered intervals likewise include zero.
Thus, provenance labels improve traceability without being responsible for the observed predictive gain.
blocks.zh:
拆除决定性的支撑边缘不会引起制造
缺少关系。 所有114项取消支助的产出结构不变
有效;在57个肯定项目中,该模型引用了48个案件中另一个可用的包内关系,在9个案件中投了弃权票,它从未引用被删除的标识符。 正项引用-尝试率从55/57下降到了48/57(XQ=-0.123\Delta=-0.123;
95% CI [−0.204,−0.039] [-0.204-0.039] (中文(简体) ).
仅删除出处信头后,预测性能基本不变: AUROC为0.8587,原为D快取,0.8480没有出处头,相对相差为−0.0108-0.0108(95% CI [−0.0579,+0.0322] [0.0579,+0.0322].
对等和候选人分组的间隔同样为零。
因此,出处标签改进了可追踪性,而不对观察到的预测收益负责。

blocks.en: Appendix M ADNI retrieval-regime stress test
blocks.zh: 附录 MADNI 检索-调控压力测试

blocks.en:
Design. The hop ladder contains five balanced families with 100 items each and manipulates only shortest-path length.
The three one-hop families are the individual legs of the longer drug–protein–disease–disease chain.
The closed-book condition supplies no graph.
Static context serializes a relation-guided packet, while the query loop lets the model issue one neighbors , find , or answer action per round.
Hop exclusivity is checked during item construction, and positives and negatives are matched on evidence length.
The experiment uses full PrimeKG because the cohort-specific phenotype-anchored graph is materialized only one hop from cohort seeds.
It therefore evaluates graph access rather than the sufficiency of the ADNI cohort-specific graph.
blocks.zh:
设计. 跳梯包含5个平衡家庭,每个家庭有100个物品,并操纵的长度最短.
三个一跳一跳的家庭是较长的药物链-蛋白质-疾病-疾病链的个人腿.
封闭式账本状况没有图表。
静态上下文序列化一个关系引导包,而查询循环则让模型发布一个邻居,找到,或每回合回答动作.
在物品构造过程中检查跳跃排他性,在证据长度上与阳性和阴性相匹配。
实验使用完整的PrimeKG,因为组群特有的苯基-安乔克图只从组群种子中实现一跳.
因此,它评价的是图表访问,而不是ADNI组别图的充分性。

blocks.en: Table 14: Balanced accuracy for three graph-access regimes in the ADNI-derived hop ladder. Gold-path presence is measured in the static packet.
blocks.zh: 表14:ADNI派生跳梯上三个图获取系统的平衡精确度。 在静态包中测量出黄金路径的存在。

blocks.en:
The regimes fail differently. Closed-book performance falls to chance at two and three hops, showing that the model does not reliably supply the missing relations from its parameters.
Static context falls below closed book in every family even though the gold path is usually present.
At two hops, it answers yes on 82% of items and has specificity 0.080.
The query loop is strong at one hop but reaches only 0.670 and 0.590 at two and three hops.
At two hops, its sensitivity is 0.340 because failed retrieval is often interpreted as evidence that a relation is absent.
Complete retrieval is therefore necessary but not sufficient, and the two graph-enabled regimes fail in opposite directions.
blocks.zh:
政权的失败有所不同。 闭账性能在两相和相去三相上落到一机之地,表明模型无法从参数中可靠地提供缺失的关系.
每个家族的静态背景都低于封闭的书本,尽管金道通常存在.
在两次跳跃时,它回答是82%的物品,并且具有特异性0.080.
查询回路在一跳时很强,但在两跳和三跳时只达到0.670和0.590.
在两次跳出时,它的灵敏度为0.340,因为失败取回经常被解释为不存在关系的证据.
因此,完全检索是必要的,但还不够,两个由图表驱动的制度在相反方向都失败了。

blocks.en:
Qualitative traces. On a one-hop enzyme question, the larger Qwen3 model independently queries the enzyme neighbors of celecoxib and warfarin, intersects the two lists, and correctly identifies CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4.
On a whole-regimen question, the smaller model repeats the same truncated disease-neighborhood query for all 15 rounds, never queries from the drug side, and returns the wrong answer.
A paired two-hop example shows a complementary static-context failure.
The packet contains the positive path from lutein through ALB to gastric neoplasm, but the model also answers yes to a negative naproxen–plasma-cell-myeloma item with no such path.
These examples show why a retrieved answer should be checked against an explicit path rather than treated as grounded simply because graph text was present.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: N.1 Audit boundary for the retrospective MIMIC split

blocks.en:
The original 3,200-item join benchmark was constructed without a development–test split, and shortcut controls were tuned while inspecting the complete item bank.
We subsequently created a patient-disjoint retrospective split (development: 802 items from 360 patients; test: 2,398 items from 1,079 patients), selected policies and thresholds on development, froze all configurations, and scored the test split once.
The held-out results therefore test model and retrieval-policy generalization within a previously designed benchmark; they are not an independent validation of benchmark construction.
The patient-side block used by these policies is admission-scoped rather than question-specific, while the PrimeKG block is candidate- and relation-conditioned.
The frozen graph and benchmark use the bridge-v1 alignment, whereas separately quoted MIMIC mapping-coverage audits use bridge v2; coverage percentages from bridge v2 should not be treated as properties of the frozen benchmark prompts.
Finally, in 4 of 1,600 positive items, the answer-bearing report finding falls beyond the frozen prompt’s 20-name report cap.
These prompts were not changed after freezing, so those cases remain in the evaluation as unavailable patient evidence.

An earlier five-packet rendering provides a separate audit of explanation traceability. With provenance present, 98.2% of outputs are valid JSON and 79.5% of cited edges exist in PrimeKG, but only 16.5% reproduce the exact answer path; evidence precision and recall are 0.312 and 0.447.

Provenance therefore makes supplied evidence inspectable, whereas correct semantic alignment is what supports the decision; neither property establishes that the underlying KG relation is clinically valid.
